content.text:
menus:
  - id: menu.settings
    key: menu.settings
    udi: prismata.menu.settings
    name: Settings
    title: Settings
    label: Settings
    position: Sub
    parent: menu.main
    order: 2
    type: settings
    icon: "⚙️"
    colourScheme: settings-menu
    borderScheme: settings-menu
    description: Minimal settings menu.
    finalItemType: Back
    header:
      udi: prismata.menu.settings.header
      text: Settings
      style: header
      colourScheme: header
      borderScheme: settings-menu
      visibilityMode: Static
    footer:
      udi: prismata.menu.settings.footer
      text: Use arrows to change values
      style: footer
      colourScheme: footer
      borderScheme: settings-menu
      visibilityMode: Static
    items:
      - udi: prismata.menu.settings.darkmode
        key: settings.darkmode
        name: Dark Mode
        label: Dark Mode
        type: toggle
        order: 1
        selectionMethod: toggle
        action: execute
        ui_framework: toggle_table
        capability: prismata.settings.toggle_dark_mode
        executeTarget: toggle_darkmode
        icon: "☾"
        colourScheme: default

      - udi: prismata.menu.settings.volume
        key: settings.volume
        name: Volume
        label: Volume
        type: slider
        order: 2
        selectionMethod: slider
        action: execute
        ui_framework: custom
        capability: prismata.settings.adjust_volume
        executeTarget: adjust_volume
        icon: "🔊"
        colourScheme: default
